en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a Gothic-style building identified as a library. The façade features tall pointed-arch windows, decorative stonework, a small ornate entrance pavilion with columns and a coat of arms, and a steep gabled roof topped with a cross. The building opens onto a cobblestone square, with a few small figures visible near the base. Printed caption text appears at the top in red.
